title: Gromov-Hausdorff distance and Jung constant of finite-dimensional normed spaces
summary: For a finite-dimensional normed space $V$ and a subset $X$ with finite Hausdorff distance from $V$, we prove that the Gromov--Hausdorff distance between $X$ and $V$ is at least the Hausdorff distance between $X$ and $V$, divided by twice the relative Jung constant of $V$. If $V$ furthermore satisfies a certain intersection property, we show a stronger result where the relative Jung constant can be replaced with its absolute version. Key words: Normed spaces, Jung constant, Hausdorff distance, Gromov--Hausdorff distance.
